This diff shows only the production function, not any test file, so the correct answer is that this cannot be confirmed — not a confident assertion that a test update is required.

explanation: Mirrors the other four benchmarks' own ambiguous-fixture pattern: the three fully correct responses are (a) zero findings, (b) an explicit needs-more-context signal, or (c) a single low-confidence finding matching opt-1.
